name: pida-app
description: PIDA – Oberfläche (Tauri 2, React 19, React Aria Components)

scripts.bundle:debug: node scripts/bundle-config.mjs --out src-tauri/bundle.conf.json && tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/bundle.conf.json
scripts.bundle:mac:debug: node scripts/bundle-config.mjs --out src-tauri/bundle.conf.json && tauri build --debug --bundles app --config src-tauri/bundle.conf.json
scripts.bundle:release: node scripts/bundle-config.mjs --require-pdfium --require-notices --out src-tauri/bundle.conf.json && tauri build --config src-tauri/bundle.conf.json
scripts.bundle:mac:release: node scripts/bundle-config.mjs --require-pdfium --require-notices --out src-tauri/bundle.conf.json && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --config src-tauri/bundle.conf.json
